name: vlm_nuclear_fragmentation_severity
description: A visual assessment score of nuclear fragmentation (karyorrhexis) and condensation. The model evaluates the DAPI channel for signs of shattered or irregular nuclear bodies indicative of late-stage apoptosis.
segmentation_prompt: Segment the nuclear region (DAPI channel) and immediate surrounding area.
method_rationale: Distinguishing true apoptotic fragmentation from mitotic chromosomes or artifacts requires semantic understanding of 'shattered' vs 'condensed' appearances.
